study: Smith et al. 2016 — Enhanced Core Reading Instruction (ECRI), Project ECRI cluster RCT, grade-1 at-risk readers, reading
delivery_evidence: Teacher PD was face-to-face: an institute before the school year plus two days of follow-up activities in October, with teaching demonstrations by ECRI expert coaches, participant practice with coach feedback, comprehensive in-class coaching support and facilitated study-group meetings; small-group instructors got 2 days fall + 1 day January PD (Method, PD section). No online PD.
test_alignment_evidence: All extracted full-sample outcomes are broad standardised independent reading instruments — WRMT Word Attack/Word ID, SAT-10 Word/Sentence/Total Reading, DIBELS NWF-WRC and ORF — none tailored to ECRI content (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Tables 1-3).
curriculum_evidence: ECRI provides a specific instructional package teachers then use: prioritized/enhanced Tier-1 routines plus an aligned Tier-2 small-group programme with ECRI intervention materials and lessons (observers confirmed 'nearly all treatment teachers used ECRI intervention materials'). It layers onto, but adds, a new materials/lessons package beyond the district's existing core reading program.
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted primary effects are the spring (fall->spring) wave — end of the grade-1 treatment year (extraction timepoint=spring Y1, end of treatment; a winter interim wave is flagged separately, not the headline).
